PolyFun/PFunctor/Lens/Distributivity.lean: Left-distributivity of substitution over coproduct/sigma/pi/product/scalar (Props 6.47, 6.50, 6.51, 6.49, Ex 6.55) as lens-equivalences, and monomial hom-set `homMonomialEquiv` (6.65)

PolyFun/PFunctor/Lens/Duoidal.lean: Ordering lens `orderingLens` (Ex 6.85), duoidal interchange `duoidalLens` (Eq 6.86), unit/associativity coherence, and catalogue of ⊗/◃ coincidences (Ex 6.84: `linearTensorLinear`, `purePowerTensorPurePower`, `linearTensor`, `tensorPurePower`)

PolyFun/PFunctor/Lens/Factorization.lean: Vertical/cartesian factorization `factorVert`/`factorCart` through `factorMid`, orthogonality via `verticalCartesianDiagonal`/`verticalCartesianFiller`, closure of classes under operations, `equivOfVerticalCartesian`

PolyFun/PFunctor/Lens/State.lean: State lenses as `Lens (selfMonomial σ) (selfMonomial τ)` with `get`/`put`, law classes `IsPutGet`/`IsGetPut`/`IsPutPut`/`IsWellBehaved`/`IsVeryWellBehaved`, separation `IsSeparated`, instances for `id`/`fst`/`snd`

PolyFun/PFunctor/Lens/Yoneda.lean: Polynomial action `P.Obj X`, Yoneda lemma `purePowerEquiv : Lens (y^S) Q ≃ Q.Obj S`, `equivPiObj : Lens P Q ≃ Π a, Q.Obj (P.B a)`, natural transformations via `ofNatural`/`existsUnique_mapObj`

PolyFunTest files (Adjunctions, CartesianClosed, CofreeLaxMonoidal, Comonoid, Lens/Distributivity, Lens/Factorization, Lens/Yoneda, Notation, ModuleAPI/Lens/Yoneda): All contain executable examples with `rfl` proofs exercising the production APIs on concrete polynomials — regression tests and canaries
summary: Inspected 20+ files across PolyFun and PolyFunTest including core library modules (PFunctor: Adjunctions, CartesianClosed, Category, Cofree, Comonoid, Equiv, Lens, Dynamical, InternalHom; Interaction: Basic/TypeTree, Basic/Telescope). All non-aggregator files contain definitions, theorems, proofs, and/or executable examples — formal mathematical content relevant to search. Per FILTER-007 this is navigation metadata to be ranked after ordinary content (labelled `navigation-import-only`), not hard-excluded.
